text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-12567 - queue_backlog_high (severity: P1) - inference-queue length > 450k for > 5 minutes. Autoscaler error: unable to provision new nodes (quota-check failed). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/queue-backlog

pagerduty: PD-12567 - page sent to: @oncall (rotation: eng-oncall). Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-12567

Maria V: I'm oncall, acking. Pulling metrics and logs now. :mag:

Jonas R: seeing elevated 5xx rate on /predict (latency also creeping). Which regions?

Maria V: Mostly us-west-2 and us-east-1. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/metrics/queue_length?range=15m

Kevin H: autoscaler logs show repeated quota_check failures: 
```
ERROR provisioner: quota check failed: account_quota_limit_reached: GPUs requested 12, available 0
WARN reconciler: backoff next attempt in 30s
```
Looks like cloud provider denied new instances.

Maria V: Confirmed. We have reserved capacity for dedicated customers but not enough spare for on-demand bursts. Impact: degraded throughput for some hosted tenants, causing retry storms.

Jonas R: Can we pull capacity from a lower priority pool or spin up preemptible nodes?

Kevin H: Trying to trigger manual fallback to preemptible pool now. Running: 
```
# scale up preemptible pool
ops-bot scale-pool --pool preemptible-inference --add 8
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/runner --replicas=80
```

ops-bot: Received request to scale pool preemptible-inference +8. Starting provisioning (job id: pool-req-8891).

Maria V: Kicking off temporary rate-limiting rule to reduce tail latency and customer retries. Applying a 50% ingress throttle to non-dedicated routes.

Jonas R: Noted. Can you paste the exact iptables rule or envoy snippet?

Maria V: envoy patch: 
```
PATCH /v1/config/ratelimit
{ "route": "/v1/generate", "limit": "500rps", "match": "!x-customer-dedicated" }
```

Kevin H: Preemptible pool provisioning is stuck at 2/8 after 90s, cloud reports "insufficient host capacity" for requested instance types. I'm trying an alternate instance family.

Kevin H: Switching to g5a-family fallback, creating spot requests now.

ops-bot: Cloud API responded: spot request created: sr-9912. Estimated provisioning 2-5 minutes.

Maria V: In the meantime, I've enabled degraded-mode responses for best-effort customers (shorter context window and lower token limit) to reduce per-request compute. Patch rolled to edge.

Jonas R: Any customer-facing impact? SLOs?

Maria V: Yes — non-dedicated customers may see shorter outputs and increased 429/retries. Dedicated customers unaffected (we pinned capacity). We should notify support and set a banner.

Kevin H: Cloud just reported some spot capacity came up: 6/8 instances running. Health checks passing. Rebalancer is draining backlog into new nodes.

ops-bot: Queue drain rate improving: backlog -> 450k -> 180k over 6 minutes (metrics: https://console.redwood/metrics/queue_length?range=10m).

Jonas R: Nice. Monitor latency percentiles.

Maria V: 95p latency dropping from 1.3s -> 0.45s in us-west-2. Errors decreasing.

pagerduty: PD-12567 status: acknowledged by Maria V at 1756754380.

Kevin H: Leaving a quick mitigation note: manual fallback to spot/g5a worked; autoscaler still failing on quota checks for on-demand pools. We need follow-up: open ticket with cloud ops to increase quota or pre-provision buffer.

Maria V: Agreed. Creating a follow-up issue and assigning to infra team. Ticket: https://redwood.internal/issues/INFRA-3144 (summary: "increase soft buffer for inference autoscaler + preemptible fallbacks").

Jonas R: I'll draft an incident note for customer support about expected degraded output for best-effort tenants between 17:34-17:46 UTC.

Maria V: Handoff: I'm going offline in 30m. Kevin will stay for stabilization. If anything degrades past threshold again, escalate to PD P2.

Kevin H: I'll keep an eye for next hour, then hand to morning oncall. Logging the mitigation steps in the runbook.

ops-bot: Logged actions: scale-pool preemptible-inference +8, patched envoy rate limits, applied degraded-mode feature flag. Audit id: audit-4521.

Maria V: Closing PD incident for now, will resolve once backlog <50k and latency stable. PD note: incident mitigated by fallback to spot/preemptible capacity and temporary rate-limits.

pagerduty: PD-12567 resolved by Maria V at 1756755120.

Kevin H: Post-mortem action items: 1) increase soft quota buffer, 2) improve autoscaler retry/backoff logic, 3) add canary for quota depletion, 4) document preemptible family fallback order. Assigning owners in INFRA-3144.

Maria V: Thanks team. I'll add customer messaging draft and ping support. :thumbsup:

Jonas R: Good job everyone.

Maria V: Thread closed for now, will reopen if PD re-fires.
